description: T-061 shared policy. pnpm ecosystem (package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml); nothing special beyond defaults. rangeStrategy is 'auto' (not 'pin') because these repos commit lockfiles while manifests keep version ranges: Renovate updates the range in the manifest and the resolved version in the lockfile together.

packageRules.description: All minor+patch updates grouped into a single PR per ecosystem.

Security updates need no extra rule: with vulnerabilityAlerts enabled, Renovate natively raises dedicated immediate PRs for vulnerable dependencies, bypassing the weekend schedule and the minor+patch group, labelled security.
